title: Gensou Suikoden
overview:
Battle, Friendship, Joy, and Sorrow... This Is a Story RPG.

Illusions Turn into Feelings...

Gather 108 companions and defeat the corrupt empire!

You play the son of a great general of the Scarlet Moon Empire, beginning a career in the Imperial Army. As corruption at the top of the empire becomes clear and a powerful rune falls into your hands, you are forced to flee the capital and end up leading a rebel Liberation Army against the empire itself.

Recruit allies across the land, fight party battles against monsters and enemy soldiers, and command your growing forces in large-scale war events between the Imperial Army and the Liberation Army. Your recruits gather at the Liberation Army headquarters, a castle that rises from a lake.

- 108 companions to find and recruit
- Large-scale army battles alongside regular party combat
- New opening movie for this version

戦い、友情、喜び、そして悲しみ…これが、ストーリーRPGだ。

幻が想いに変わる…

108人の仲間を集めて腐敗した帝国を打ち倒せ!
